heading: Organization defined
lead: As used in this title, the term “organization” means a person other than an individual.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 1988—Pub. L. 100–690 made technical correction of directory language of Pub. L. 99–646, § 38(a), similar to that made by Pub. L. 100–185. 1987—Pub. L. 100–185 made technical correction in directory language of Pub. L. 99–646, § 38(a).
